preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of direct connections m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The index of the server that fails v must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to connect the servers in the required way, output '-1'. Otherwise, output m lines describing the direct connections.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.split()) == 2 for line in return_value if return_value != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly two integers representing a direct connection.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n for a, b in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1'))
postconditions.description: Each server index in the output must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(a) != int(b) for a, b in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1'))
postconditions.description: Each direct connection must link two different servers.

postconditions.expression: all((int(a), int(b)) not in [(int(c), int(d)) for c, d in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1')] and (int(b), int(a)) not in [(int(c), int(d)) for c, d in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1')] for a, b in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1'))
postconditions.description: Each pair of servers should have at most one direct connection.

postconditions.expression: all(any((int(a), int(b)) in [(int(c), int(d)) for c, d in (line.split() for line in return_value if return_value != '-1')] for a, b in [(i, j) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(i+1, n+1) if i != v and j != v])
postconditions.description: When server v fails, the system must still be connected for all other pairs of servers.
